configurationSources.server_jvm/src/main/resources/applicatio:
xa:
  mass:
    kernel-pacer:
      preset: ${XA_MASS_KERNEL_PACER_PRESET:SCENARIO_LAB}
    redis:
      scope: ${XA_MASS_REDIS_SCOPE:profile_scenario_workers}
    worker-delivery:
      adapter:
        instances:
          scenario-websocket:
            type: WEBSOCKET
            listen-host: 127.0.0.1
            listen-port: 18083
            command-backoff: 100ms
            command-consume-limit: 100
            command-retry-capacity: 1000
            report-backoff: 1s
            report-queue-capacity: 1000
            reconnect-verification-retention: 10m
            maximum-disconnected-workers: 100000
            maximum-encoded-properties-bytes: 67108864
            send-time-limit: 5s
            shutdown-timeout: 5s
    worker-endpoints:
      defaults:
        WEBSOCKET: scenario-websocket
      endpoints:
        scenario-websocket:
          transport-type: WEBSOCKET
          public-uri: ws://127.0.0.1:18083/api/v1/worker-delivery/websocket
    worker-assembly:
      group-config-json: |
        {
          "scenario-phone-number-workers": {
            "attributes": {"capability":"libphonenumber"},
            "eventCodes": [
              "extension.worker.phonenumber.e164",
              "extension.worker.phonenumber.country",
              "extension.worker.phonenumber.original-carrier"
            ]
          },
          "scenario-string-utils-workers": {
            "attributes": {"capability":"string-utils"},
            "eventCodes": [
              "extension.worker.string.md5",
              "extension.worker.string.sha1",
              "extension.worker.string.base64.encode",
              "extension.worker.lab.checkpoint"
            ]
          },
          "android-demo-workers": {
            "attributes": {"capability":"android-demo-capabilities"},
            "eventCodes": [
              "extension.worker.android.state.read",
              "extension.worker.android.battery.read",
              "extension.worker.android.string.digest",
              "extension.worker.lab.delay",
              "extension.worker.lab.fail"
            ]
          }
        }

server:
  address: ${SERVER_ADDRESS:127.0.0.1}
  port: 18082

spring:
  jackson:
    deserialization:
      fail-on-unknown-properties: true
  web:
    resources:
      static-locations: file:../frontend/dist/

xa:
  mass:
    kernel-pacer:
      enabled: ${XA_MASS_KERNEL_PACER_ENABLED:true}
      preset: ${XA_MASS_KERNEL_PACER_PRESET:DEFAULT}
      shutdown-timeout: 5s
    redis:
      url: ${XA_MASS_REDIS_URL:redis://localhost:6379/15}
      scope: ${XA_MASS_REDIS_SCOPE:profile_default}
    worker-endpoints:
      defaults:
        POLLING: system-polling
      endpoints:
        system-polling:
          transport-type: POLLING
          public-uri: http://127.0.0.1:${server.port:18082}
    task-rpc:
      default-wait-timeout-millis: 30000
      max-wait-timeout-millis: 60000
      max-waiters: 10000
      max-pending-observations: 100000
      max-probe-items-per-round: 256
      initial-probe-interval-millis: 50
      normal-probe-interval-millis: 100
      long-probe-interval-millis: 250
    direct-call:
      default-wait-timeout-millis: 3000
      max-wait-timeout-millis: 10000
      max-adapter-commands-per-adapter: 1000
      max-pending-calls: 10000
    worker-delivery:
      adapter:
        remote-base-url: http://127.0.0.1:${server.port:18082}
        remote-request-timeout: 5s
        verification-queue-capacity: 100000
        verification-timeout: 5s

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health
  endpoint:
    health:
      probes:
        enabled: true
      group:
        readiness:
          include: readinessState,kernel,kernelRedis,workerMatching

springdoc:
  paths-to-match: /api/v1/**

scalar:
  enabled: true
  path: /scalar
  url: /v3/api-docs
  page-title: XA Mass Runtime API
  with-default-fonts: false
  telemetry: false
  agent:
    disabled: true
